reviews.text:
This was the first time I left my Toy Poodle, Chai, with Lulu since moving to London. Chai is quite sensitive, so I was a little worried, but Lulu took such wonderful and thoughtful care of him that he stayed happy and healthy throughout his stay.

I also really appreciated how clean and comfortable Lulu’s home is. A clean and well-kept environment is important to me when choosing someone to look after my dog, and it gave me even more peace of mind knowing Chai was in such good hands.

Thank you so much, Lulu! I would definitely ask you to look after Chai again.

We couldn’t be happier with the wonderful care Lulu gave our toy poodle, Leo, while we were away on holiday for two weeks. He was safe, happy and so well looked after, which gave us complete peace of mind while we were away.
We also take Leo to Lulu for the day sometimes, and he absolutely loves it. He gets so excited to see Lulu and all the other dogs and always comes home happy and tired.

Lulu is amazing with the dogs and we wouldn’t hesitate to recommend her. Leo absolutely adores her🐾❤️

We highly recommend Lulu, the most important thing for us is that our Bubbles absolutely loves her, she is just so happy and excited to come over whenever she sees Lulu’s house even from distance. We feel very lucky as we can travel with confidence our puppy will be safe and well taken care for.

We recently moved from LA with our 4 year old Maltipoo, Ollie, and I was really worried about finding a good boarding place for him when we traveled as we had a great dog sitter. When I found Lulu, it was the best thing ever! Ollie boarded with her for 5 days and it was like home away from home! He enjoyed a lovely time with the other dogs, and was very well looked after by Lulu with lots of cuddles! She will be our go to person everytime we travel. I couldn’t be happier and nor can Ollie!

Lulu has been amazing with our Boston Terrier, Hendrix. He didn't have the best start in life and was very nervous around new people and other dogs, but he's really taken to Lulu. She's been able to introduce him too some other suitable dogs and he's really built up his confidence. He now even has a few doggy friends and even let's them share his blanket. Can't thank Lulu enough!!
Simply amazing!!! Best dogsitter ever! Our dog loves being at Lulu's!

I can’t recommend Lulu enough! She took amazing care of our beloved Bacon while we were away. Bacon is usually quite reserved but loves to play and has a sensitive stomach, yet Lulu ensured he was happy, well-fed, and well-entertained. She kept me updated with regular messages, photos, and videos, which gave me complete peace of mind. When Bacon came home, he was very happy and clearly well cared for. It’s evident that Lulu has a true passion for animals and treats them like family. I’ll definitely be booking her services again—highly recommended!

I can’t say enough great things about Lulu!!  She took such wonderful care of my Beagle puppy Benji, (who really is a bit of a handful) while I was away, ensuring he was happy, well-fed, and entertained. Lulu provided regular updates, including pictures, which gave me peace of mind. My pup came back home relaxed and clearly well-loved. It’s obvious that Lulu genuinely cares for animals and treats them like their own. I highly recommend her services and will definitely be booking again! Fleur x
Tyson (chow chow) was very calm at collection. Highly recommend, wonderful communication :)
